validation_errors.scope: One highest-scoring accepted segment per UID, first stored on ties; observed direction, not verified client/service role. Aggregate bins only, no endpoint/UID/feature rows.

resources.scope: Frame loading, six pattern audits, fits, scoring, serialization and controls; excludes imports, preparation and input verification. 50 ms RSS samples are not OS-enforced limits.

scope: Candidate-label, capture/time-separated accepted subset only, unverified devices and incomplete DDoS coverage. Richer measurements are verified, not proof of improved attack truth or performance. Report failures and keep every repeated/conflicting input; pilot remains deferred.
